decisions.reason: A click-in track adapter is a cheap accessory that keeps the firm's track lighting system compatible, so it is likely to stay in the catalogue.
Single LED luminaires are often replaced by newer generations after about four years, but there is no clear sign of withdrawal and newer families may simply sit alongside it.
A home automation server box is outside the firm's core lighting business and faces fast-moving competition, which raises the risk of dropping it, but it may still serve the installed customer base.
A luminaire family with its own page was a central product line and is likely kept with updates rather than withdrawn.
